preservation_contract: On a successful nonzero-size realloc, the retained byte prefix has length min(old_size,new_size); this wrapper performs no explicit per-record rearrangement when a width changes.
Neither wrapper explicitly initializes newly grown coordinate, connectivity or direct-integer buffer tails. Do not infer zeros or default values from these bodies.

Results overwrite pointer slots without explicit null checks in these bodies. Do not equate this native failure behavior with a safe portable implementation contract.
